claims.quote: SLC6A1-related disorder is a genetic neurodevelopmental disorder that is caused by loss of function variants in the SLC6A1 gene.

claims.object_text: GABA transporter type 1 (GAT1); reuptake of GABA from the synaptic cleft
claims.quote: Solute Carrier Family 6 Member 1 (SLC6A1) gene encodes for gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) transporter type 1 (GAT1), which is responsible for reuptake of GABA from the synaptic cleft.
Consequently, individuals with SLC6A1-related disorder can have manifestations such as developmental delay, epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, and a subset have developmental regression.
